bodyHtml:
ROT-14 Reverse Osmosis Storage Tank

60-Liter (14 Gallon) High-Capacity Tank for Commercial & Public Systems| Aquasky RO-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

The ROT-14 is a high-capacity pressure tank (60 liters/14 gallons) for commercial reverse osmosis systems, large offices, and public drinking water setups, ensuring safe, pure, high-pressure water delivery. 

 

It supports a maximum operating pressure of 7 bar (100 psi) and a temperature of 90 °C (194 °F). Factory pre-charged with 100% nitrogen to 0.5-0.7 bar (7-10 psi), it offers stable performance unaffected by temperature. 

 

Measuring 39.0 cm (15.4 in) in diameter and 60.4 cm (23.8 in) in height, this stand-model tank includes a heavy-duty plastic base for sturdy support and water savings in commercial settings.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The ROT-14 is a 60-liter (14 gallon) diaphragm pressure tank engineered specifically as a high-capacity Commercial Reverse Osmosis (RO) drinking tank. Designed to process 60 liters per hour, the ROT-14—which is equivalent to the industry standard RO1070—is highly suitable for supplying clean water for up to 15 people. It securely stores a large volume of purified water and delivers it into the plumbing system with steady control, pressure.

ROT-14 is ideal for commercial applications. Its highly hygienic internal design separates the stored water from the compressed gas and completely prevents water from making direct contact with the internal metallic tank shell. Utilizing an FDA-approved polypropylene liner and a DIN 4807-compliant butyl rubber diaphragm, the ROT-14 ensures exceptionally safe operation, delivering cleaner, fresher, and better-tasting water while maintaining a tasteless water zone absolutely free of any rubber or plastic smells.

Manufactured with premium materials and holding top-tier certifications including NSF58, CE, and IAPMO, Aquasky RO tanks are produced in ISO 9001:2008 registered facilities to deliver a long service life, dependable performance, and the safest drinking-water compatibility on the market.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • Epoxy powder exterior paint for high protection against oxidation and fine finish.
  • Stainless-steel water connection: lead-free, chemical-free, patented leak-safe technology (Aquasky invention in 18 years).
  • High-performance butyl rubber diaphragm meets DIN 4807.
  • Internal virgin FDA-approved polypropylene liner prevents water-to-metal contact.
  • Patented leakage-free O-ring sealed air valve cap.
  • 100% factory pre-charged with nitrogen (not air).
  • 100% pressure tested before shipment for ultimate reliability.
  • High customization available for distinct market branding.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the RO-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

ROT-14 stores supplemental water securely between the butyl rubber diaphragm and the polypropylene liner, while the nitrogen-filled air chamber maintains constant system pressure. When a drinking tap or coffee maker is activated, the compressed nitrogen pushes the purified water into the system at a controlled pressure.

This specialized design ensures stable performance, completely separates the water from the metal shell, and maintains a clean water zone that is completely free of rubber or plastic odors.

Key benefits

  • Delivers cleaner, fresher, and better-tasting water by isolating the water supply from metals and plastics
  • Provides a tasteless water zone with absolutely no rubber or plastic smells
  • Guarantees zero air loss and exceptional air resistance, outperforming other tanks on the market
  • Completely maintenance-free during its entire expected service life

Typical Applications

  • Standard Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems (60L per hour production)
  • Small food shops, cafes, and commercial kitchens
  • High-capacity drinking water systems (suitable for up to 15 people)

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : Is the ROT-14 safe for storing drinking water in a commercial or public system?

Yes. The ROT-14 uses a high-grade polypropylene liner and a butyl diaphragm made with FDA-approved materials, which completely prevents the water from ever making contact with the steel tank shell. 

This guarantees a tasteless water zone with no rubber or plastic smells, making it perfectly safe for clean drinking water in commercial and public applications. Furthermore, the stainless-steel connector is completely chemical-free and lead-free.
 

Q2 : Can the ROT-14 handle a public drinking water station?

Yes, the ROT-14 is a commercial-grade 60-liter (14-gallon) tank capable of delivering 60 liters per hour. It is perfectly designed for large offices, commercial setups, and public drinking stations supporting up to 15 people.
 

Q3 : Does the ROT-14 require regular maintenance or air recharging?

No. The ROT-14 is designed to be entirely maintenance-free during its service life. We utilize a specialized brass cap with an internal O-ring that guarantees no air loss from the air vent. 

Additionally, it is the only RO storage tank in the industry pre-charged with 100% Nitrogen, which naturally resists permeation and prevents pressure fluctuations caused by temperature changes.
